_comment: Was a plain STATIC holding an INJECT_TRIGGER, and nothing dispatches a plain STATIC -- so the trigger was never injected and the granted ability never existed. Its INJECT_TRIGGER also named ON_ATTACK, which is dispatched only to the ATTACKING CARD's slug -- an aura granting an ability to other cards can never receive it. ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK reaches every permanent the attacker controls, which is exactly the hook a granting permanent needs; the weapon half is excluded because the card says attack ACTION cards. Its 'destroy this' was END_OF_TURN, but the card says the beginning of the END PHASE.
